name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-pixel-art
description: LLM-driven GDI+ text-to-image for DeepSeek Harness: the agent's own LLM writes a System.Drawing (GDI+) PowerShell script that the plugin renders with the built-in powershell.exe into a PNG, shown inline in the conversation (no external image API). Also serves previously generated pixel-art images.
